incident-bot: Paging: high error rate observed on /v1/serve (canary group 'alpha-3') — 5xx increase 12% over baseline, canary traffic ~37%. Pager: @Sam (oncall-sre) ...
Sam (oncall-sre): I'm on it. Can folks post canary vs baseline diffs and recent deploys? Any customer pages?
Luis (customer-success): got 3 support tickets flagged in last 10m, all report "responses truncated" or "internal error". CX impact seems limited but visible. I'll surface to affected accounts.
Priya (ml-eng): checking canary logs now. If traffic is 37% of requests to alpha-3, that should be enough to reproduce. Asking Maya for runtime metrics and model commit id.
Maya (eng-runtime): pulling canary host logs. Attaching tail of nginx error and model runtime stack for last 15m:
```
[2025-06-15T18:10:12Z] ERR 500 POST /v1/serve - model_handler.cpp:kv_lookup failed: invalid_kv_size
[2025-06-15T18:11:03Z] WARN latency spike 1.8s -> 3.2s on gpu-node-07
```
Also runtime shows repeated "KV_CACHE_MISS" spikes aligned with errors.
Priya (ml-eng): canary model id: redwood-model-v3-quant-2025-06-15@sha256:abc123. Baseline pinned to redwood-model-v3-quant-2025-06-01@sha256:fff999. I have a quick diff of tokenizer/config that changed token-splitting whitespace handling (likely from tokenizer upgrade). Diff summary:
```
- tokenizer.vocab['\n'] -> split into two tokens
+ tokenizer.vocab['\n'] -> single token
```
Hypothesis A: tokenizer change caused KV cache keys to be inconsistent between cache population and lookup, triggering invalid_kv_size and deserialization errors.
Sam (oncall-sre): that's a strong hypothesis. How widespread — is it only canary variant with new tokenizer? Confirmed by pinning check?
Priya (ml-eng): yes, only alpha-3 uses the new tokenizer. Baseline kept previous tokenizer. I ran a quick local sim and saw KV deserial failures when tokenization produced different prefix sizes.
Jared (product-ops): business impact: estimated 6% request failures across canary, ~2% overall platform error increase. Customer impact low for now but could escalate if rollout continues. Recommend rollback of canary to previous tokenizer while we debug.
Maya (eng-runtime): to rollout/rollback: ability to pin model variants by canary group is available. Running deploy command to pin alpha-3 -> baseline sha. Will run in 2m and share logs. @Priya can you confirm model build compatibility for immediate pin?
Priya (ml-eng): confirmed. No schema changes other than tokenizer. Rollback safe.
Sam (oncall-sre): executing rollback now. Command:
```
/deploy pin --canary alpha-3 --model-sha fff999 --reason "in-flight KV cache errors"
```
Sam (oncall-sre): deploy bot: Rollback started by Sam. Rolling alpha-3 to redwood-model-v3-quant-2025-06-01@fff999
Sam (oncall-sre): rolling status: 20% -> 60% -> 100% complete. No increase in 5xx post-rollback so far.
incident-bot: Incident update: mitigation applied — canary pinned to previous tokenizer. Severity downgraded to P2. Continue monitoring for 30m.
Luis (customer-success): noted, I'll inform affected accounts and mark tickets with mitigation. :thumbsup:
Priya (ml-eng): next steps: collect full timeline, attach model commit diffs, run targeted unit test on tokenization->kv interactions, and postmortem doc. I'll own root-cause and tests. @Maya can you collect full host logs and KV cache dumps?
Maya (eng-runtime): yes, exporting logs and KV dumps to /tmp/incidents/1745601234-logs.tar.gz and sharing link: https://files.redwood.internal/1745601234-logs.tar.gz
Sam (oncall-sre): creating incident doc and timeline: https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/1745601234. Assigning RCA owners: Priya (root cause), Maya (runtime follow-up), Sam (operational actions). Will keep channel open for updates.
Jared (product-ops): quick note: add a gating step to canary rollout to validate tokenizer/kv compat in the pipeline. Without that, similar regressions can slip through.
Priya (ml-eng): agreed. I'll add a small unit that hashes tokenization outputs and validates expected kv key lengths in CI for model builds.
Sam (oncall-sre): last check 18:25Z — 5xx rate back to baseline. Closing active paging, keeping thread open for RCA coordination.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigated). Follow-up: RCA doc required within 72h. Incident channel will be archived after RCA is posted.
Sam (oncall-sre): thanks everyone. Good job moving quickly. :clap:
